title: Card payment declined after verification
summary: Review a declined card payment without creating duplicate authorisations or holds.
steps: Check the transaction timeline for a pending authorisation before retrying.
Confirm the customer has not reached their card or daily payment limit.
If the hold is still pending after 10 minutes, do not submit another payment. Record the reference and escalate.

title: Transfers showing as pending
summary: Check the transfer timeline and expected arrival window before raising a report.
steps: Open the transfer details and confirm the expected arrival window.
Check whether the beneficiary is new or needs additional verification.
If the expected window has passed, capture the transfer reference and report it.

title: Refreshing a locked customer session
summary: Restore a stalled customer session without repeating a payment or transfer.
steps: Confirm the customer is not in the middle of a pending payment or transfer.
Return to the customer overview and reopen the session once.
If the session locks again, stop and report the time and customer-safe reference.

title: Update a customer's contact or address details
summary: A controlled checklist for maintaining customer demographic details.
steps: Complete the required identity and authority checks using the approved customer-verification process before viewing or changing a profile.
Confirm the exact fields the customer asked to change and review the current record with them.
Update only the authorized fields, check spelling and contact details, and save the change in the customer record.
Read back the changed fields and confirm the update outcome without exposing unrelated account information.
If verification fails, a field is restricted, or the record does not save, do not retry with guessed details; follow the approved escalation route.

title: Open an additional customer account
summary: Preparation and confirmation steps for an associate-assisted account opening.
steps: Find the correct customer record and complete the required identity, eligibility, and authority checks under current policy.
Confirm the requested product, key terms, fees, access method, and any required disclosures with the customer.
Complete required suitability, consent, funding, and application checks for the selected product before submission.
Submit once and wait for a confirmed outcome. If the result is pending or unclear, check the application status before trying again.
Confirm the account reference and status to the customer, and record any required follow-up using the approved workflow.

title: Customer profile does not match submitted details
summary: Resolve a mismatch carefully without overwriting the verified customer record.
steps: Pause the requested change and confirm the customer record using the approved identity-verification process.
Compare the submitted value with the existing profile and clarify the exact correction with the customer.
Do not change verified identity attributes solely to bypass a validation error or application control.
If the mismatch remains, capture the non-sensitive error reference and route it to the authorized profile-maintenance team.

title: New account application is pending
summary: Check an incomplete account-opening result before starting another application.
steps: Search the customer record for an application or account created during the current session.
Review the application status and any outstanding verification or customer actions.
Do not submit a duplicate application while the original request is pending.
If the status has not updated within the expected processing window, capture the application reference and follow the product support route.
